exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members as per e1; no alternates or substitutes are mentioned in the evidence.

exclusions.name: Public comment or procedural delays
exclusions.why_safe: The agenda lists final action (e2), and rules allow voting unless postponed (e11); no evidence suggests public comment would prevent a vote.

exclusions.name: Remote participation
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence and no remote provision exists (e4), so remote voting is impossible.

nodes.meaning: The official record of the vote on Ordinance 2026-14 at the 8 September session, showing each council member's vote.

cutoff.meaning: The end of the regular session on 8 September 2026, after which the vote outcome is known.

attrs.negative_condition: Ordinance 2026-14 receives fewer than three affirmative votes (including a tie or failure) at the 8 September session, or is not voted on at that session.
attrs.positive_condition: Ordinance 2026-14 receives at least three affirmative votes at the 8 September session.

nodes.meaning: The question is resolved by whether Ordinance 2026-14 receives at least three affirmative votes from the five-member council at the 8 September 2026 regular session.
